name: Nave
author: E. T. Carter
description: Looking up a stone cathedral nave whose ribbed pointed vault recedes bay after bay toward a deep orange glow at the far end, while broad dusty sun shafts slant down from the clerestory at the upper right across blue-black piers onto a flagstone patch barred by the window leading. The sun slowly climbs and sinks so the shafts sweep, clouds dim them in turn, and motes turn in the light as the view creeps down the nave.

params.label: Sunlight
params.effect: Strength of the sun through the windows, from an overcast gloom to blazing shafts.

params.label: Cloud drift
params.effect: How fast clouds pass the windows, dimming one shaft after another.

params.label: Dust
params.effect: How much dust hangs in the air, from faint shafts to thick beams full of motes.

params.label: Walk
params.effect: Speed of the slow walk down the nave.
